name: codex-wechat-channel
description: Bridge WeChat ClawBot messages into Codex app-server threads

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js start
scripts.setup: npm run build && node dist/cli.js setup
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/copy-runtime-assets.mjs
scripts.probe: npm run build && node dist/cli.js probe
scripts.bridge:start: npm run build && node dist/cli.js bridge start
scripts.bridge:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.js bridge status
scripts.bridge:stop: npm run build && node dist/cli.js bridge stop
scripts.bridge:probe: npm run build && node dist/cli.js probe
scripts.service:install: npm run build && node dist/cli.js service install
scripts.service:status: npm run build && node dist/cli.js service status
scripts.service:uninstall: npm run build && node dist/cli.js service uninstall
scripts.lint: eslint cli.ts src scripts test tools
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include="dist/cli.js" --include="dist/src/**/*.js" --include="dist/scripts/**/*.js" --exclude="dist/test/**" --exclude="dist/tools/**" --check-coverage --lines=70 --branches=60 --functions=60 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary node --test dist/test/*.test.js && node dist/tools/check-coverage.js
